experiment: WP3: paired prospective (sliding-window) replication of E8

prereg.declared: 2026-11-22, written into this file before any outcome of this experiment was computed
prereg.question: Is in-window insertion into s6 of the frozen model (historical insertion) a useful proxy for a rating that arrives in the next snapshot s7 under sliding-window inference (window s1..s7, same weights)?
prereg.targets: per seed: low-reputation targets of the frozen clean model (>= 2 raters in s0..s6, clean R in [0.5, 0.6)) that are also eligible after the clean slide (>= 2 raters in s1..s7, clean post-slide R >= 0.5); one target set for both placements
prereg.sources: per seed and target: one uniform draw of 5 distinct accounts that are not the target and do not rate it in s0..s7, RandomState([SOURCE_SEED, seed, target]); B=1 uses the first, B=5 all five; the same sources in both placements
prereg.baselines: in-window: clean frozen reputation; sliding: clean reputation after the same slide
prereg.estimand: per seed: paired difference sliding minus in-window of (a) the propagation-only flip rate, in percentage points, and (b) the mean propagation-only shift; across seeds: the mean of the ten per-seed differences with a seed-clustered percentile bootstrap 95% CI (10,000 resamples of seeds, RandomState(12345))
prereg.criterion: historical insertion is a useful proxy on a dataset at budget B if the 95% CI of (a) lies within [-10, +10] percentage points AND the 95% CI of (b) lies within [-0.02, +0.02]
prereg.verdict_rule: evaluated per dataset and budget (B = 1 and B = 5); the dataset-level verdict is 'useful proxy' only if both budgets meet the criterion

verdict.dataset_verdict: not shown to be a useful proxy (criterion not met)

secondary_not_predeclared.note: targets low-reputation under BOTH clean placements (post-slide R also < 0.6); not part of the verdict
